veranderings.voor: so sleg dat dit hom skade doen
veranderings.na: so sleg dat dit hom skade aandoen
veranderings.rede: The idiomatic verb with a person as object is 'iemand skade aandoen'.
'Los 'n merk' copies English 'leave a mark'; standard Afrikaans is 'laat 'n merk'.

veranderings.voor: Dit los geen merk op die liggaam nie.
veranderings.na: Dit laat geen merk op die liggaam nie.
veranderings.rede: Same as in the previous block: 'laat 'n merk', not 'los 'n merk'; keeps the two blocks parallel.

veranderings.na: kleineer hom of maak hom bang
veranderings.rede: 'Maak hom klein' is a literal rendering of 'make him feel small'; 'kleineer' is the Afrikaans verb, and 'maak hom bang' stays.

veranderings.voor: laat hom voel hy is nie gewens nie
veranderings.na: laat hom voel niemand wil hom hê nie
veranderings.rede: 'Nie gewens nie' copies English 'not wanted'; 'niemand wil hom hê nie' says the same in natural Grade 5 Afrikaans.

veranderings.voor: Mishandeling raak 'n kind se gesondheid en nie net sy liggaam nie.
veranderings.na: Mishandeling raak nie net 'n kind se liggaam nie, maar sy hele gesondheid.
veranderings.rede: The 'nie net ... maar' construction reads more naturally and avoids implying that the body is not part of health.
A comma between the two verbs that end the relative clause and start the main clause aids reading; the protected words stay intact.

veranderings.voor: Party voel baie bang en ander voel kwaad vir mense om hulle.
veranderings.na: Party voel baie bang, en ander voel kwaad vir die mense rondom hulle.
veranderings.rede: AWS comma before 'en' joining two clauses with their own subject and verb; 'rondom hulle' is clearer than the ambiguous 'om hulle'.

veranderings.voor: of bly van ander kinders af weg
veranderings.na: of bly weg van ander kinders
veranderings.rede: 'Van ... af weg' is a clumsy double particle; 'bly weg van' is the natural form.

veranderings.blok: Dit is nooit die kind se skuld nie
veranderings.rede: A comma between the two verbs where the relative clause ends and the main clause begins.

veranderings.blok: Dit is nooit die kind se skuld nie
veranderings.voor: stop te sit is die werk
veranderings.na: stop te sit, is die werk
veranderings.rede: A comma after the long 'om ... te' subject clause, where two verbs meet.

veranderings.blok: Vertel dit vir iemand wat jy vertrou
veranderings.voor: jy vertrou soos 'n onderwyser of ouma
veranderings.na: jy vertrou, soos 'n onderwyser of 'n ouma
veranderings.rede: Without the comma 'soos' can be read as 'trust the way a teacher does'; the repeated article keeps the two examples parallel; the protected phrase stays intact.

veranderings.blok: Vertel dit vir iemand wat jy vertrou
veranderings.voor: wat jou bang maak is nie
veranderings.na: wat jou bang maak, is nie
veranderings.rede: A comma between the two verbs at the end of the relative clause and the start of the main clause.

veranderings.blok: Vertel dit vir iemand wat jy vertrou
veranderings.voor: gaan na 'n veilige plek of ander mense
veranderings.na: gaan na 'n veilige plek of na ander mense
veranderings.rede: Repeating 'na' makes clear the child goes to other people, not to a place 'or other people'.
'Iets privaat hou' copies English 'keep private'; 'vertroulik hou' is the standard Afrikaans and avoids 'geheim'.
With a person as object the idiom is 'skade aandoen'; 'aspris' stays.

veranderings.voor: te gaan se wat gebeur het
veranderings.na: te gaan sê wat gebeur het
veranderings.rede: The verb 'sê' needs its circumflex; 'se' is the possessive.

vlae.teks: Wanneer 'n grootmens of 'n ander kind 'n kind aspris skade doen.
vlae.rede: The study block also counts treating a child so badly that it harms him (no 'aspris') as abuse, so the glossary entry, read alone, is narrower than the lesson's own definition; that is a content question for the writer, not a language fix.
The title names only an adult, while the protected sentence in the first block says another child can do it too; the title may not be changed by this step, so it is flagged for the writer.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Moenie later teruggaan om die persoon daaroor aan te spreek of te stry nie, grootmens of kind
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: 'Stry' without a partner reads incompletely; natural Afrikaans is 'of met hom te stry'. Left unchanged because it is protected.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Om dit verder te neem is die werk van grootmense soos
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: 'Iets verder neem' is a calque of English 'take it further', and the sentence would normally take a comma before 'is'; both left unchanged because the wording is protected.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: As dit veilig is, mag jy 'Nee' sê en weggaan, ook vir 'n grootmens by die huis
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: This sentence writes 'Nee' quoted and capitalised, while the protected sentence two lines later writes 'nee sê' plainly; the two are inconsistent in one block, but both are protected.

beskerm_bedenkings.woord: Dan kan hulle 'n maatskaplike werker of die polisie inbring
beskerm_bedenkings.rede: 'Inbring' for involving people is close to English 'bring in'; 'betrek' or 'laat kom' would be more standard, but the wording is protected.
